about: The Workbench icons of the CursesTetris drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art in art/ is drawn by amiga/icons/draw_art.py (upstream's picture is a screen recording). CursesTetris-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, CursesTetris.info beside the drawer. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-Tetris and LICENSE.txt.
